svg.title: Pocket Pixel / another dimension
svg.desc: An isometric preview of the same voxel mesh available as an STL file. Pixel has a violet body, a pink antenna, and raised mint eyes inside a recessed face. Open the model in GitHub to rotate and zoom. The preview gently floats; reduced motion keeps it still.

g.text: A tiny voxel bot, ready to turn.
OPEN THE STL / NATIVE GITHUB VIEWER
